posts: Late night session: layered a dusty Rhodes loop over an 808 pattern that won't quit. Mixing notes to self — less reverb, more air. Rough mix drops on #nearfm when it stops fighting me. #music
Reminder: the demo isn't the song. Bounced a rough mix of 'Static Bloom' tonight and forced myself to close the laptop. Fresh ears tomorrow, vocals after. Small wins on #near. #music
